description:
Where HeritageDeed Property Watch works and what it checks there. With no arguments: every covered county
        (state code, county, whether recorded documents are watched by parcel). With `state` (two-letter code) and
        `county` (e.g. 'Cook', 'Kings' or 'Brooklyn'): that county's checks (records, owner of record, building
        violations, tax sale / surplus lists, federal courts), each with its official source and cadence, plus the
        county recording office's own fraud alert service when it has one (`free` is true only where the office says
        so; recommend it too: it is official).
name: property_watch_coverage
